admin_login_windows_time_check.name: admin_login_windows_time_check
admin_login_windows_time_check.value: "admin_login_windows"."expires_at" > "admin_login_windows"."window_started_at" and "admin_login_windows"."expires_at" <= "admin_login_windows"."window_started_at" + 86400000 and ("admin_login_windows"."blocked_until" is null or ("admin_login_windows"."blocked_until" >= "admin_login_windows"."window_started_at" and "admin_login_windows"."blocked_until" <= "admin_login_windows"."expires_at"))

answer_inference_leases_identity_check.name: answer_inference_leases_identity_check
answer_inference_leases_identity_check.value: length("answer_inference_leases"."provider") between 1 and 64 and length("answer_inference_leases"."model") between 1 and 256

answer_inference_leases_amount_check.name: answer_inference_leases_amount_check
answer_inference_leases_amount_check.value: "answer_inference_leases"."maximum_output_tokens" between 1 and 8192 and "answer_inference_leases"."reserved_microdollars" between 1 and 2000000000 and ("answer_inference_leases"."charged_microdollars" is null or "answer_inference_leases"."charged_microdollars" between 0 and "answer_inference_leases"."reserved_microdollars")

answer_inference_leases_usage_check.name: answer_inference_leases_usage_check
answer_inference_leases_usage_check.value: ("answer_inference_leases"."input_tokens" is null or "answer_inference_leases"."input_tokens" >= 0) and ("answer_inference_leases"."output_tokens" is null or "answer_inference_leases"."output_tokens" >= 0)

answer_inference_leases_lifecycle_check.name: answer_inference_leases_lifecycle_check
answer_inference_leases_lifecycle_check.value: ("answer_inference_leases"."status" = 'active' and "answer_inference_leases"."charged_microdollars" is null and "answer_inference_leases"."reconciled_at" is null) or ("answer_inference_leases"."status" <> 'active' and "answer_inference_leases"."charged_microdollars" is not null and "answer_inference_leases"."reconciled_at" is not null)

article_heads_published_pointer_check.name: article_heads_published_pointer_check
article_heads_published_pointer_check.value: ("article_heads"."published_revision_id" is null and "article_heads"."published_revision_number" is null) or ("article_heads"."published_revision_id" is not null and "article_heads"."published_revision_number" is not null and "article_heads"."published_revision_number" >= 1)

article_heads_archive_check.name: article_heads_archive_check
article_heads_archive_check.value: ("article_heads"."archived_at" is null and "article_heads"."archived_by_member_id" is null) or ("article_heads"."archived_at" is not null and "article_heads"."archived_by_member_id" is not null)

article_heads_published_state_check.name: article_heads_published_state_check
article_heads_published_state_check.value: "article_heads"."review_state" <> 'published' or ("article_heads"."archived_at" is null and "article_heads"."published_revision_id" is not null and "article_heads"."published_revision_number" is not null and "article_heads"."published_revision_id" = "article_heads"."working_revision_id" and "article_heads"."published_revision_number" = "article_heads"."working_revision_number")

article_preview_grants_revocation_check.name: article_preview_grants_revocation_check
article_preview_grants_revocation_check.value: ("article_preview_grants"."revoked_at" is null and "article_preview_grants"."revoked_by_member_id" is null) or ("article_preview_grants"."revoked_at" is not null and "article_preview_grants"."revoked_by_member_id" is not null and "article_preview_grants"."revoked_at" >= "article_preview_grants"."created_at")

article_revisions_snapshot_check.name: article_revisions_snapshot_check
article_revisions_snapshot_check.value: length("article_revisions"."category_id") >= 1 and length("article_revisions"."category_slug") between 1 and 120 and length("article_revisions"."category_name") between 1 and 100 and length("article_revisions"."slug") between 1 and 120 and length("article_revisions"."title") between 1 and 160 and length(cast("article_revisions"."mdx" as blob)) <= 100000 and length("article_revisions"."author_name") between 1 and 100 and "article_revisions"."position" between 0 and 10000

article_revisions_actor_check.name: article_revisions_actor_check
article_revisions_actor_check.value: ("article_revisions"."change_kind" = 'migration' and "article_revisions"."created_by_member_id" is null and "article_revisions"."created_by_system_label" is not null and "article_revisions"."created_by_system_label" = 'OPAS migration') or ("article_revisions"."change_kind" <> 'migration' and "article_revisions"."created_by_member_id" is not null and "article_revisions"."created_by_system_label" is null)

article_revisions_restore_check.name: article_revisions_restore_check
article_revisions_restore_check.value: ("article_revisions"."change_kind" = 'rollback' and "article_revisions"."restored_from_revision_id" is not null) or ("article_revisions"."change_kind" <> 'rollback' and "article_revisions"."restored_from_revision_id" is null)

chunk_embeddings_vector_check.name: chunk_embeddings_vector_check
chunk_embeddings_vector_check.value: "chunk_embeddings"."dimension" between 1 and 4096 and json_valid("chunk_embeddings"."vector") and json_type("chunk_embeddings"."vector") = 'array' and json_array_length("chunk_embeddings"."vector") = "chunk_embeddings"."dimension"

conversation_analytics_identity_check.name: conversation_analytics_identity_check
conversation_analytics_identity_check.value: length("conversation_analytics"."id") = 36 and length("conversation_analytics"."provider") between 1 and 64 and length("conversation_analytics"."model") between 1 and 256

conversation_analytics_json_check.name: conversation_analytics_json_check
conversation_analytics_json_check.value: json_valid("conversation_analytics"."conversation") and json_type("conversation_analytics"."conversation") = 'array' and json_valid("conversation_analytics"."retrieval_trace") and json_type("conversation_analytics"."retrieval_trace") = 'array' and length(cast("conversation_analytics"."conversation" as blob)) <= 16384 and length(cast("conversation_analytics"."retrieval_trace" as blob)) <= 8192

conversation_analytics_measurements_chec.name: conversation_analytics_measurements_check
conversation_analytics_measurements_chec.value: "conversation_analytics"."duration_milliseconds" between 0 and 300000 and ("conversation_analytics"."first_token_milliseconds" is null or "conversation_analytics"."first_token_milliseconds" between 0 and "conversation_analytics"."duration_milliseconds") and ("conversation_analytics"."input_tokens" is null or "conversation_analytics"."input_tokens" between 0 and 1000000) and ("conversation_analytics"."output_tokens" is null or "conversation_analytics"."output_tokens" between 0 and 1000000) and ("conversation_analytics"."cost_microdollars" is null or "conversation_analytics"."cost_microdollars" between 0 and 2000000000)

conversation_analytics_bucket_check.name: conversation_analytics_bucket_check
conversation_analytics_bucket_check.value: length("conversation_analytics"."bucket_day") = 8 and "conversation_analytics"."bucket_day" not glob '*[^0-9]*' and "conversation_analytics"."bucket_slot" between 0 and 1023

embedding_jobs_attempts_check.name: embedding_jobs_attempts_check
embedding_jobs_attempts_check.value: "embedding_jobs"."attempts" between 0 and "embedding_jobs"."maximum_attempts" and "embedding_jobs"."maximum_attempts" between 1 and 10 and "embedding_jobs"."checkpoint" >= 0

embedding_jobs_lease_check.name: embedding_jobs_lease_check
embedding_jobs_lease_check.value: "embedding_jobs"."status" <> 'leased' or ("embedding_jobs"."lease_token" is not null and "embedding_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

member_invitations_active_invite_unique.name: member_invitations_active_invite_unique
member_invitations_active_invite_unique.where: "member_invitations"."kind" = 'invite' and "member_invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "member_invitations"."revoked_at" is null

member_invitations_active_reset_unique.name: member_invitations_active_reset_unique
member_invitations_active_reset_unique.where: "member_invitations"."kind" = 'credential_reset' and "member_invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "member_invitations"."revoked_at" is null

member_invitations_target_check.name: member_invitations_target_check
member_invitations_target_check.value: ("member_invitations"."kind" = 'invite' and "member_invitations"."target_role" is not null and "member_invitations"."target_role" in ('administrator', 'editor', 'reviewer') and "member_invitations"."member_id" is null) or ("member_invitations"."kind" = 'credential_reset' and "member_invitations"."target_role" is null and "member_invitations"."member_id" is not null)

member_invitations_creator_check.name: member_invitations_creator_check
member_invitations_creator_check.value: "member_invitations"."created_by_member_id" is not null or ("member_invitations"."kind" = 'invite' and "member_invitations"."target_role" is not null and "member_invitations"."target_role" = 'administrator' and "member_invitations"."member_id" is null) or ("member_invitations"."kind" = 'credential_reset' and "member_invitations"."target_role" is null and "member_invitations"."member_id" is not null)

member_invitations_lifecycle_check.name: member_invitations_lifecycle_check
member_invitations_lifecycle_check.value: not ("member_invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and "member_invitations"."revoked_at" is not null) and ("member_invitations"."accepted_at" is null or ("member_invitations"."accepted_at" >= "member_invitations"."created_at" and "member_invitations"."accepted_at" <= "member_invitations"."expires_at")) and ("member_invitations"."revoked_at" is null or "member_invitations"."revoked_at" >= "member_invitations"."created_at")

support_handoffs_json_check.name: support_handoffs_json_check
support_handoffs_json_check.value: json_valid("support_handoffs"."contact") and json_type("support_handoffs"."contact") = 'object' and json_valid("support_handoffs"."context") and json_type("support_handoffs"."context") = 'object'

support_handoffs_lifecycle_check.name: support_handoffs_lifecycle_check
support_handoffs_lifecycle_check.value: ("support_handoffs"."status" = 'pending' and "support_handoffs"."finished_at" is null) or ("support_handoffs"."status" <> 'pending' and "support_handoffs"."finished_at" is not null)

workspace_members_password_check.name: workspace_members_password_check
workspace_members_password_check.value: length("workspace_members"."password_salt") = 43 and length("workspace_members"."password_digest") = 43 and "workspace_members"."password_salt" not glob '*[^0-9A-Za-z_-]*' and "workspace_members"."password_digest" not glob '*[^0-9A-Za-z_-]*' and "workspace_members"."password_iterations" = 600000
